ROLE DIRECTORY Grade : JM1/JM2 Function : Manufacturing Location : PDRI Department : Production Qualification : D. Mech or Equivalent Role Title: Member Operations
- Boiler Roles & Responsiblities, Role Specification & Key Deliverables of the Role Role Synopsis The role would primarily involve Handling of Utility areas
- Utility control [Boilers, DG Set, Compressors, Raw Water Treatment Plant, Cooling towers, MCC Panel, Transformer , HT yard, Water storage tank, Routine & Break down Maintenance], ensuring man machine relationship through TPM, conducting RCA for breakdown, conducting periodic maintenance to minimize breakdowns. Key Duties & Responsiblities Daily Routine Roles Member of utility to have control of the Equipment throughout the shifts Ensuring the Chemical dosage of cooling tower and Boiler feed water Maintain water treatment plant uptime (100%) and run WTP with the optimized set conditions Maintain Boiler uptime (100%) and run boiler with optimized set conditions Maintain Compressor uptime (100%) and run Compressor with optimized set conditions Maintain Power Factor to unity, Maximum demand with allowed limit and 100% Adherence of Peak hour & other restricted hour load shutting at TNEB Side Recording the E.B log and boiler log sheet RAC (Root Asset care ) to be done shift wise and for any abnormalities found to be captured Housekeeping of utility areas & scrap generated to be moved to the scrap yard as per RMS Shift wise Data entering in DPR , SAP for all the KPI's relate to the shift Optimize utility start up and set up conditions during power failure and D.G change over Jointly Responsible for the total shift production including machine and process efficiency Skills and Competencies Exposure in Production , Maintenance & Boiler Operations Good communication skills in English and Tamil Computer Literacy Basic knowledge of TPM, 5S and Six sigma Boiler B Certificate from Tamil Nadu Govt Organizational Relationships Band : JM1 / JM2 Operationally Reports to: Production Executive/ Manager Functionally Reports to: Production Executive/ Manager Reportees: Nil Internal Interface: Commercial, SCM, PQA, HR, Internal Auditors External Interface: Auditors, Vendors, 3P units

title: Manager - Data Engineering and Analytics
jobDescription:
Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Manage and mentor a team of Power BI developers and Snowflake data engineers, ensuring high-quality deliverables and professional growth Partner with internal IT business application managers who serve as IT partners to functions such as Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, R&D, and Finance to understand data and analytics needs Ensure uptime, reliability, and smooth performance of Snowflake (data platform) and Power BI (analytics/reporting) environments Drive an Analytics Center of Excellence (Co E) for the IT function — continuously scout, evaluate, and onboard better solutions and vendors to improve the company's analytics landscape Define the enterprise data architecture framework, including security, reference data, metadata, and master data standards Define and implement a roadmap for Data Lifecycle Management and Self-Service Analytics across the organization Run the Master Data Management (MDM) Co E across the organization — ensure master data integrity and quality across all systems Identify data sources (internal and external) and develop a systematic plan for data management, including API frameworks for data retrieval Conduct continuous audits of the data management system covering performance, cost usage, and security — report any breaches or loopholes immediately to stakeholders Own cost management of data hosting vis-à-vis the technology stack, mapped with the lifecycle of data Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors for smooth functioning of the enterprise data ecosystem Provide training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members on best practices, tools, and emerging trends Collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors for smooth functioning of the enterprise data system. Provide training to other team members on best practices
